name: cx-box
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` only requires carrying the box at or after a fall, but the task says to pick it up again. `holding_box` is a persistent condition, so already carrying the box when it falls can satisfy this clause without picking it up again. Require a pickup event after each fall; the declared propositions do not include a pickup event, so the candidate cannot express this requirement.

CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` only requires carrying the box at some later step; the task says to pick it up again whenever it falls, so use `ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)` to require pickup on the very next step.

CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` does not capture “pick it up again.” `box_fell` is a one-step event, so Response allows the box to be picked up on the fall step itself; the task requires picking it up afterward. Use `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` only if the wording permits same-step pickup; here the required follow-up needs a rule that enforces a later step.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(box_fell, holding_box) does not require picking the box up again after it falls; it allows holding_box on the same step as the fall. The task says to pick it up again, so require holding_box after box_fell, not on the fall step.

CHANGES REQUIRED: `Response(box_fell, holding_box)` requires carrying the box at a later step, but the task says to pick it up again after each fall. Replace it with `ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)` so pickup is required on the very next step.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(box_fell, holding_box) is too weak for “whenever the box falls, pick it up again.” It permits holding the box at the fall step, without picking it up again afterward. Require a later pickup after each fall, not merely carrying the box on or after the fall.

CHANGES REQUIRED: Response(box_fell, holding_box) only requires carrying the box at or after a fall. The task says to pick it up again, so require a pickup after each fall; `holding_box` is a lasting condition and could already be true on the fall step, which does not ensure the box was picked up again.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires carrying the box at the exit, and Response(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking it up again after each fall.

texts: Reach the exit while carrying the box.
Be carrying the box when reaching the exit.
Whenever the box falls, be carrying it again afterward.
